subject: Pilot: surge capacity request and flexible credit/extension options
messages:
From: Alice Wang <alice@vertexai.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vertex Analytics Procurement <procurement@vertexai.com>
Date: Sun, 09 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Pilot: surge capacity request for final integration test

Hi Irene —

Thanks again for the help so far. We’re scheduling a final integration run for the PoC the week of Aug 17th and expect a short, high-concurrency stress window (~48 hours) while our inference layer is connected. During that window we project ~3x the token volume compared to our current pilot usage.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provide either a short timebox extension (1–2 weeks) at no additional cost so we can finish the validation, OR a block of surge/burst credits we can consume during the run?
- If you offer credits, can we get a discounted rate for that block? Procurement is ready to agree quickly if commercial terms are simple.

I attached the latest security questionnaire and the updated SOW for context.

High-level deadline: we need confirmation by EOD Mon (Aug 10) to lock infra.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Alice

Attachments: Vertex_Security_Questionnaire.pdf, PoC_SOW_v2.docx

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Wang <alice@vertexai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 09 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: surge capacity request for final integration test

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. We can support the run; below are two pragmatic options so procurement can pick quickly:

Option A — Timebox extension (no charge):
- 1 week extension to the existing pilot at no base cost, limited to a 50% usage cap above your current average to protect shared capacity.
- Requires signing a one-page PoC addendum (I attached a draft).
- Good if you want to avoid upfront spend; impact: lower max throughput.

Option B — Surge credits (recommended for peak runs):
- Block of 200k token credits at a 35% discounted uplift vs list pilot rate.
- Valid for the Aug 17–31 window; can be consumed during the 48-hour stress window.
- No usage cap during the stress window.

We can also do a hybrid: give you 100k complimentary credits + 100k purchased credits at 25% off if you sign the addendum and commit to a conversion milestone (simple: PO or contract signature within 30 days).

Marcus (sales) and Monica (CS) are looped in to confirm pricing and coordinate SOW/addendum. If you prefer, Marcus can send a short commercial addendum and a DocuSign link.

Irene

Attachment: PoC_Addendum_20260810.docx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Wang <alice@vertexai.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 14:20:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: surge capacity request for final integration test

Thanks for the context, Alice — quick commercial proposal to unblock procurement:

Offer (hybrid, preferential):
- 100,000 complimentary tokens (on us) to cover initial verification traffic.
- 100,000 billed tokens sold as a surge block at $0.0008/token (25% off our standard pilot uplift). Total = $80.00 for the purchased block.
- One-week complimentary extension to the pilot window (Aug 17–24) if addendum signed; full two-week extension available at purchase of an additional 100k block.

Conversion incentive: if Vertex signs a committed Dedicated pilot (min $5k ARR) or issues a PO within 30 days, we’ll credit the $80 back against the first invoice.

Next steps:
1) If you accept, procurement can either a) send PO referencing DEAL-8342 and PO#4521, or b) sign the DocuSign link below.
2) Monica will reach out to schedule a short (30m) run-day ops call to finalize orchestration.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sandbox/ABC-12345
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/8342

I’ll prep a one-page addendum and an invoice once you confirm the route.

— Marcus

Attachment: PoC_Addendum_20260810.docx

From: Alice Wang <alice@vertexai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vertex Analytics Procurement <procurement@vertexai.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: surge capacity request for final integration test

Marcus / Irene —

Appreciate the speedy options. Procurement is happy to proceed with the hybrid offer. We will:
- Issue PO#4521 for the purchased 100k surge tokens (we’re attaching the PO).
- Accept the 100k complimentary tokens and one-week extension (Aug 17–24) per the addendum.
- Vertex will target signing a committed pilot agreement within the 30-day window.

Monica — please coordinate the ops call for Tues Aug 18 morning EDT if you have availability. Also confirm when we can expect the DocuSign addendum so procurement can cross-reference.

Thanks — attaching PO for records.

Best,
Alice

Attachment: Purchase_Order_4521.pdf
